title: Native Hawaiians and Easter Islanders came from same 'ultravoyager' group
caption:
New research reveals that the ancestral roots of Native Hawaiians and Easter Islanders trace back to the same group of skilled Pacific voyagers. By analyzing modern genomes, scientists have uncovered the deep connections between these far-flung island nations.

Source: Livescience - Native Hawaiians and Easter Islanders came from same 'ultravoyager' group

https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/native-hawaiians-and-easter-islanders-came-from-same-ultravoyager-group
